project_title: Luxury Content Creator for Business Pitches and Brochures

project_metadata.job_title: Luxury Content Creator for Business Pitches and Brochures
project_metadata.job_description: We are seeking a skilled content creator who specializes in crafting luxurious and captivating business pitches, brochures, and portfolios. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail and the ability to convey our brand's values through high-quality content. Your work will be pivotal in impressing stakeholders and clients, so a strong background in luxury branding is essential. Please showcase your previous work that aligns with high-end demands.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I want to make sure we both have the same understanding. Our initial discussion covered image design only, not a complete monthly hiring arrangement, which honestly does not suit me at this stage.
The agreed amount for the work was $100, which works out to approximately $13 per image/page. However, the volume of work and requested revisions has exceeded what we discussed originally.
I’ve made a genuine effort to cooperate and have completed multiple changes, but it is inaccurate to repeatedly request major redesigns while describing the work as “template-based.” I have every original source file, and all the work was properly created from scratch.
The scope has now clearly expanded. If you want additional work or further revisions, the price will have to be adjusted accordingly. If not, I cannot continue making more changes under the existing terms.
Thank you for understanding. Please tell me how you would like to move forward.

messages.speaker: freelancer

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I will have to raise my charges after April 25 because I have already spent more than a month working on this project. Even so, the work remains unapproved and continues to be changed. A significant amount of work is still outstanding, and the earlier tasks have not yet been finalized either.
This situation prevents me from progressing efficiently. Sometimes I am expected to follow Samuel’s instructions, while at other times I must follow yours, resulting in an inconsistent workflow. I cannot continue working this way.
If you are comfortable with this arrangement, that is fine. Otherwise, I kindly ask that we wind up the project here. The total payment is \$150, although the work includes more than 20 pages and has already required over a month.
I have repeatedly asked you to accept the Upwork milestone, but it still has not been accepted. I have cooperated fully from my side, yet my concerns continue to be overlooked. It is also not reasonable for me to work under directions from two different people.
Please try to understand my position. I still have other pending work, and remaining stuck on this project will cause a considerable loss of my time, effort, and mental focus.
Please finalize the previous work so that I can continue. Otherwise, you can give the remaining work to someone else.
Thank you for understanding.
